intro.title: Scenario I: River of Blood
intro.body: “Whatever you have to do to stop her, to stop that thing,” Christopher says to you as you prepare to set out in search of Julia. “Just do it.” You spend the night searching frantically through the Waterfront District, but are unable to locate anything conclusive. You retire for a restless night, and hope to have better luck in the morning.

setup.gatherSets:

River of Blood
Blood Blight
Blood Moon
Children of Blood
Hunted
Infected
Misinformation

Vermin
Dead Ends{'{'}asterisk{'}'}

If you are playing on Hard or Expert difficulty, DO NOT gather the _Preyed Upon_ and _Vermin_ encounter sets. Instead, gather all cards from the following encounter sets:
Mongrels
Vermin
setup.gatherAdditionalSets:
Additionally, if there are 3 or 4 investigators, gather all cards from the following encounter set:
Afflicted
setup.placeLocations: Put each location into play, as follows:
setup.dawn: If you are playing on Easy or Standard difficulty, put each _Dawn_ location into play. Remove each _Dusk_ location from the game.
setup.dusk: If you are playing on Hard or Expert difficulty, put each _Dusk_ location into play. Remove each _Dawn_ location from the game.
setup.startAt: Each investigator begins play at Water Street.
setup.waterfrontCivilians: Spawn 1 Waterfront Civilian enemy at Main Street.
setup.additionalWaterfrontCivilians: If there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game, also spawn 1 Waterfront Civilian enemy at Garrison Street.
setup.juliaStern: Gather each copy of the Julia Stern enemy.
setup.onTheRun: If you are playing on Easy difficulty, set Julia Stern (*On the Run*) aside, out of play. Remove each other copy of Julia Stern from the game.
setup.stalkingTheStreets: If you are playing on Standard difficulty, set Julia Stern (*Stalking the Streets*) aside, out of play. Remove each other copy of Julia Stern from the game.
setup.preyingUponArkham: If you are playing on Hard or Expert difficulty, set Julia Stern (*Preying Upon Arkham*) aside, out of play. Remove each other copy of Julia Stern from the game.
setup.setOutOfPlay: Set the following cards aside, out of play: each remaining Waterfront Civilian enemy, each Night Feeder enemy (or each Spawn of Zburamoarte enemy if playing on Hard or Expert difficulty), each card in the _Infected_ encounter set, the Detective Reynolds story asset, and the Fang of Zburamoarte story asset.
setup.lairs: Shuffle the top 2 cards of the encounter deck together with the set-aside Julia Stern enemy. Place 1 of these cards facedown, at random, beneath each _Lair_ location.
